message.content:
Lowbed trailers for transporting heavy machinery fall under heading 8716. Subheading 8716.39 covers other trailers and semi-trailers for the transport of goods. Within it, 8716.39.00 has statistical suffixes: 8716.39.0030 is for "Other: Trailers... of a kind designed for transport of goods... Other", though I am working from memory and have not checked these. I recall that 8716.39.00 breaks down as 8716.39.0010 (Trailers and semi-trailers for agricultural use), 8716.39.0030 (Trailers... other, 0050?), and 8716.39.0090 (Other).

The subheading structure I recall:
- 8716.39.00 – Other
- 8716.39.0010 – Trailers... agricultural
- 8716.39.0030 – Tank trailers?
- 8716.39.0040 – Container chassis? That may fall under 8716.39.0040 or 8716.39.0050.
- 8716.39.0090 – Other

I'm fairly sure that 8716.39.0090 is the general "other" for goods transport trailers. Since the unit comes disassembled and complete, it is classified as the complete trailer under GRI 2(a). A lowbed trailer is a semi-trailer or full trailer. Pulled by an ADT, it is likely a semi-trailer, but either way it falls under 8716.39. I'll go with 8716.39.0090.
